findings.title: Metric alert handler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` inherits `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract methods, including `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the new occurrence hook. When a detector with this registered group type accesses `detector_handler`, instantiating the handler raises `TypeError` instead of allowing detector processing to proceed. Implement the required methods or keep this handler concrete.
